subject.title: [Bug]: scripts/pr GraphQL sync can lose rebased ancestry

question: Should maintainers refresh and land the existing ancestry-repair PR, replace it with a narrower branch-publication fix, or preserve the current GraphQL fallback behavior?
rationale: The item has a protected `maintainer` label and the fix changes PR branch publication semantics that can intentionally fail closed for maintainer workflows, which is a real owner decision rather than cleanup automation.

options.title: Refresh linked repair PR
options.body: Update and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98765 against current main, then land it if script owners accept the stricter publication behavior.

options.title: Open narrower replacement
options.body: Use the linked PR as source work but replace it with a smaller branch that only adds the GraphQL ancestry guard, lease pinning, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep current fallback semantics
options.body: Leave this issue open or close the repair PR only if maintainers explicitly decide that automatic GraphQL publication should remain compatible despite stale ancestry risk.

recommendation.title: Refresh linked repair PR
recommendation.body: Update and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98765 against current main, then land it if script owners accept the stricter publication behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked repair PR and recent prep-push refactor, and are the clearest owner for deciding whether to refresh or replace that branch.
